title: Failed to process a Websocket message - while using Slider + st.dataframe height
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

[![Open in Streamlit Cloud](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-11299)

This is a very easy to reproduce bug.  If it matters we have a almost 100k row dataframe.

There is a slider:
rows_to_show = st.slider("Rows to show", min_value=10, max_value=100, value=20, step=10)

Which adjusts the height of the df:
st.dataframe(df, height=40 + (rows_to_show * 30)) # <- yes a little math voodoo

However, if you adjust the height and then re-adjust the height (or slider) prior to the dataframe finish loading, this error is thrown. 

For now, I will hard code a frame height. 

Issue raised in webpage:
Failed to process a Websocket message. Error: Cached ForwardMsg MISS [hash=918983c443e8f49e31d63646dea52973]. This is not expected to happen.
